evidence_class: Analytical synthesis of existing accepted measurements; no new ML, optimization, physical PG or causal selection.
refinements: Net cross-layer reinforcement does not establish collinearity, redundancy, excess LR or useful credit.

Fixed-bank comparison uses the full joint Gram H=2*stored_Gram and a supported credit covector on the SAME states/metric/chord; ill-conditioned coefficient cancellation and finite retractions can invalidate its optimum.
PPO joint six-action ratio selects whole-sample active masks; a Fisher second moment cannot determine removed credit or inactive fraction.
Native mean/total-concentration components are nonorthogonal and differ from mode/excess precision; small concentration cost does not prove zero physical credit.
Near-bound mode, inward mean and pooled torque thresholds do not identify a torque ceiling or gait optimum.
historical_layer_scope: One replayed next-rollout full-batch proposal per saved checkpoint; functional evaluation on 512 stored states, distinct from actual first/ten-epoch updates.
